_comment: HIGH and CRITICAL gosec findings in _test.go files, per rule, as of the
1.0.0 hardening pass. CI fails if any rule exceeds its number here, so this
can only be lowered. It is not a suppression list: a new InsecureSkipVerify
or a new hardcoded credential in a test still turns CI red.
Production code is scanned separately and must stay at zero; it is at zero.
Lower a number whenever you remove a finding. The CI step prints the exact
replacement block when a count drops.
